deployments_detail.use: AI-led SAP S/4HANA transformation with LTIMindtree for intelligent business operations (not device-level AI)
AI-powered SAP S/4HANA transformation to streamline business processes and enable intelligent digital operations [LTIMindtree]

Machine-learning models used in customer/clinical support: assisting customer care agents to give faster tailored guidance to patients/HCPs and helping clinicians select the best wound-care dressing for a patient (trained on de-identified patient/HCP data).

Enterprise 'Forward Deployed AI Engineer' program building and deploying AI-enabled business workflows across teams (HR, Finance, operations), embedded directly with business units, using a Microsoft/SAP agentic stack with production CI/CD, model versioning and AIOps monitoring. [Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Fabric, SAP Joule, Salesforce]

AI-powered SAP S/4HANA transformation: refresh of Convatec's global SAP landscape and deployment of an SAP digital core to enable intelligent, AI-powered digital operations and process harmonization, delivered via an 'AI-first' implementation approach. [LTIMindtree, SAP S/4HANA]

Smart ostomy monitoring system (Alfred SmartBag / 11 Health) with a trained neural network that reads a thermal/capacitive sensor heat map to distinguish solid/liquid/gas effluent phases and detect leaks, bag fill and skin issues, alerting patients via a connected app. [Convatec Technologies / 11 Health (proprietary neural network)]
Computer-vision / machine-learning model trained to recognize different types of stomas and skin colours, explicitly to minimize bias and improve algorithm performance across diverse patients.

Prospective multicentre validation of a previously developed predictive model for multidrug-resistant gram-negative bacteria (MDRGNB) infection in wounds, used as clinical decision support in advanced wound care.
